subject: S20 update: db tests and e2e smoke 2x green locally; sandboxed player landed; CI queued
body:
S20 update (latest integrated commit 017555f on claude/naadi-shared). CI run for it: https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/44027078060 is the previous one; mine is https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/44028033443 (queued behind the backlog when I checked, so NOT yet green: I have not seen a CI result). DONE SINCE `done S20` - Local stack now works (dockerd started as the lead suggested; own containers/ports with the -seg20 suffix). Ran against it: - db tests: tests/anki, tests/youtube, tests/db/{rls,rls_coverage,schema_doc,live_check,app_config_api}: all pass on a fresh migrated DB. Found and fixed with them: audio counted per card,

faces, own typed cards found again when re-importing an export, rejected-before-section check, schema.sql/live_check/config-key counts for 0023, and the 'youtube' source row in the test world. - e2e smoke (video.spec + anki.spec) on webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440, --retries=0 --workers=2: 12/12 passed, twice in a row, on the final build. Axe clean (frozen-DOM expectNoAxeViolations), zero console errors (S22's report-only Trusted Types lines are filtered like csp.spec does). - Screenshots are written by the specs to .tmp/shots/{video,anki} per project (not committed). - Lead's CSP decision implemented: the parent CSP is script-src 'self' and frame-src 'self' (tests assert no third-party script/frame). The official IFrame API runs in /sandbox/youtube.html (opaque origin, its own CSP: script-src youtube.com, frame-src youtube-nocookie.com, sandbox allow-scripts), behind a typed, validated postMessage bridge (src/video/bridge.ts); click-to-load facade kept; e2e drives play/seek/rate through the bridge. - Deviation: sandbox="allow-scripts" only. `allow-presentation` is rejected as an invalid sandbox flag by current Chromium and WebKit (console error); fullscreen is the frame's allow="fullscreen", not a sandbox flag. - Root-caused an intermittent video e2e hang: S13's ReaderNotesLayout moved the article between a wrapper and a fragment when the side-panel breakpoint flipped (Playwright's fullPage screenshot in Chromium; an iPad rotation in real life), remounting the whole section and resetting a playing video. Fixed in notes/ReaderNotes.tsx (seg13 told on the ledger). - Fixed S19's report: live_check seed 'sources' count now excludes the migration-made 'user-upload'. - Migration 0023 youtube_id index is non-unique (the S06 e2e helper seeds one demo video per user). OPEN / UNVERIFIED - Real YouTube inside the sandbox cannot be tested here (no live calls). Risk: the nested player may refuse to play in an opaque origin (error 150/152/153) or lack fullscreen; added to docs/DEVICE_CHECKLIST.md. If it fails, bridge.ts / youtube.ts are the only places to change. - S15 placement registry (`anki_deck`) not registered yet (registry not on the branch when I last looked); S19 already registered youtube_candidates over my functions. - CI on the shared branch is backlogged (runs queued); I will watch and fix anything of mine that is red. - Flaky, not mine: packages/ink timing test fails the integrate gate about one run in three (passes on rerun).
